children: LME aluminium (MAL3=LX) looks neutral in a range of $3,179-$3,274 per metric ton, and an escape could suggest a direction.
The range is formed by the 114.6% and the 86.4% projection levels of a downtrend from $3,563. A break below $3,179 may trigger a fall into a range of $3,100-$3,149.
However, the bias might be toward the upside, as the consolidation in the range has lasted so many days that it indicates a resumption of the uptrend from $3,040.
A break above $3,274 may lead to a gain to $3,356.
